scoring_justification: The bandgap is recomputed from the raw PDOS data; this is the core of the paper's claim and is fully derivative from the agent’s DFT calculation.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper conclusion text and Fig 3: bandgap ~1.0 eV for TiO2-(101) sheet (PBE).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Value extracted from paper; tolerance set to ±0.2 eV based on typical DFT spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: It is the actual paper-reported number, so scoring is faithful to the replication target.

outputs.description: Projected density of states data for Ti-3d and O-2p orbitals. The file enables verification that a clear energy gap exists in the DOS around the Fermi level.
The PBE single-particle bandgap in eV, computed as the energy separation between the valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum in the PDOS.

output_contract.notes: Only the (101) electronic structure is scored. Optical properties, bulk bandgap, and (001) sheet are excluded per scope.
